query.description: The id of the team.

request.description: Invites a user (specified using the `email_address` parameter) to your Team. If the user does not currently have a Dropbox Sign Account, a new one will be created for them. If a user is already a part of another Team, a `team_invite_failed` error will be returned.

request.description: Removes the provided user Account from your Team. If the Account had an outstanding invitation to your Team, the invitation will be expired. If you choose to transfer documents from the removed Account to an Account provided in the `new_owner_email_address` parameter (available only for Enterprise plans), the response status code will be 201, which indicates that your request has been queued but not fully executed.
